title: File #2364's six review-needs-pr limits in docs/debts/notes.md
why: #2364's PR body lists six limits of rule review-needs-pr with an Until date, but the notes store does not, so they leave view once the PR merges.
note: From lane record-after-each-round, round 3 reviewer (sonnet) PASS on #2364, 02:05 CST Nov 10. Docs-only step after #2364 merges: copy the six limits (Until: 2026-11-21) from #2364's PR body into docs/debts/notes.md: (1) NEEDS_PR_NAMED (hooks/guard_merge.py ~:1722) refuses rare PR forms ("PR for #12", "PR [#12]", a bare "#12"); one retry clears it. (2) The regex counts text that names no PR ("PR 3 times", "lane-pr-1234"); a brief naming only the stacked parent passes. (3) A fix-check brief from CLAUDE.md's fix-check text names no PR, so its first spawn is refused (~:1760); a debt if it recurs. (4) A repo with no PRs is refused on a reviewer spawn; the exemption keys on the remote alone (~:1734). (5) Not judged: a plugin-prefixed role (x:reviewer) and Workflow-tool spawns. (6) skills/design-review/SKILL.md:36: blind reviewers now see the PR number. #2364 waits on batch 72, after #1678 (runner 8,  CST Nov 10).
